content.text:
I added `乾闥婆	乾闼婆` to `data/dictionary/TSPhrases.txt`, so the traditional-to-simplified phrase dictionary now converts 乾闥婆 to 乾闼婆 instead of 干闼婆. I haven't built or run any tests, and I didn't add a test case for it.

I placed the entry between 乾道 and 乾陵 to keep the file's codepoint order. The same file is used by the `hk2s`, `t2s`, `tw2s` and `tw2sp` configs, so all of them get the fix.

The compiled dictionaries under `build/` still contain the old data. They need a rebuild before the change takes effect.
